posts.caption: This is what real workers think of Pauline Hanson.

Victorians deserve to know who and what they're voting for.

What have Pauline, Warren, and One Nation got to hide?

A One Nation-Liberal Government will mean the kinds of cuts, closures and chaos that would make Jeff Kennett blush.

That's why proud westies Jesse and Rob hit the streets in Werribee to talk about the things that matter most - funding public education, keeping our hospitals in public hands, and protecting our rights at work.

We know that One Nation and the Liberals are in it for themselves and their billionaire mates. 

That's why we're out in communities across the state talking to voters about the things that matter.

Join us at the link in our bio.

Yesterday, we joined locals from @bencarrollmp 's electorate to welcome him to the job as Victoria's new Premier! Our message: clean energy cuts bills, so please ramp up government efforts to help get solar on every roof and build more clean energy and better public transport. 

Thanks to  @better_buses , @weare.union , @mooneevalleysustainability  and everyone who joined in to help spread the message. 

#cleanenergyforall
Tax increases for working people and tax cuts for her millionaire and billionaire mates. Does Pauline Hanson’s plan for a 25% flat tax rate sound fair to you?
While local council workers in their union @asu.victas fight for fair pay and better conditions, the cosplay crew in the Victorian Liberal Party are proving that they still have no idea 🙄
Council workers in their union @asu.victas  aren't wasting a second - they called a snap rally today outside Parliament to remind MPs that they're not going anywhere until they get a fair pay offer.

Yesterday the community gathered to celebrate VicHealth, braving the wet Melbourne winter in bright colours.

For nearly 40 years VicHealth has provided independent and innovative health promotion programs that put the health of Victorians first. VicHealth is a vital public service.

We know that without proper investment in health prevention, life expectancy decreases and ambulance and hospital demand skyrockets.

Victoria needs VicHealth to stay independent, fully-funded and strong.
Nurses, midwives and healthcare workers know it – Pauline Hanson and One Nation will be disastrous for Victoria’s health.

Victorians hate One Nation's attacks on our penalty rates, our unfair dismissal laws, and on struggling workers.

But you know who reckons that One Nation is just great?

Jess Wilson and the Victorian Liberals.

They're still refusing to stand with Victorians and commit to putting One Nation last this November.

Jess Wilson and the Liberals are making a choice - and they're not choosing you.

Like cane toads and Kyle Sandilands, some things should never be allowed to jump the Murray - that’s why union members were out from Wodonga to the city this morning distributing 50,000 copies of “Quotations from Pauline Hanson”.

We know that Pauline Hanson has the best spin doctors that Gina Rinehart’s money can buy - but we’ve got thousands of union members who are taking action every day to spread the word about the cuts, closures and chaos a One Nation-Liberal Government would mean for Victoria.
Statement from Victorian Trades Hall Council Secretary Luke Hilakari on the retirement of Sally McManus and Michele O'Neil
